description: Stage a package, inspect pending versions, download a tarball, or approve/reject a stage. Approval publishes the version; rejection removes the staged version. Requires an npm CLI supporting npm stage.

otp.description: 2FA code for approving or rejecting a stage

package.description: Optional package spec to filter the list

path.description: Package directory for publish; destination directory for download

stageId.description: Required for view, download, approve, and reject

name: stage
